title: Mario's earlier hypnotic regression triggers atrial fibrillation

tellings.quote: The regression itself, which caused Mario to relive the experience, was so traumatic for him that it caused his heart to go into atrial fibrillation.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of Mario Woods, one of a group of Air Force veterans who say they were taken by aliens decades ago. Michels says that years earlier Mario went through hypnotic regression, where a hypnotist helps someone relive buried memories, and reliving the event was so traumatic that his heart went into atrial fibrillation, a dangerous irregular heartbeat. Michels tells it to show how real and deep the experience feels to Mario.
